atoms.b: Daniel the dragon is ill. The wizard makes a healing potion. The potion cures Daniel.

instruction.text: Which of these do you think is the main idea?

hint.text: The main idea is the most important message.

atoms.b: Daniel wants to thank the wizard. Daniel makes some biscuits and gives them to the wizard. The wizard really likes the biscuits.

instruction.text: Which of these do you think is the main idea?

hint.text: The main idea is the most important message.

b.sound: The wizard goes to the park.

atoms.b: The wizard loses his staff. Daniel flies over the neighbourhood looking for it. The wizard finds his staff in the closet.

instruction.text: Which of these do you think is the main idea?

hint.text: The main idea is the most important message.

b.sound: The wizard loses and finds his staff.
Daniel goes on holiday in the neighbourhood.
